knowledge:
- key_parameters: maxTxLength=The maximum length in nucleotides to restrict transcripts to from their 3' ends ;; minDistance=The minimum distance between 3' ends below which transcripts are merged ;; genome=A BSgenome object corresponding to the genome of the TxDb object ;; file=Output file path; ending with .gz automatically enables gzip compression ;; BPPARAM=An optional BiocParallel parameter (e.g., MulticoreParam) to parallelize the truncation step
- alternatives: txdbmaker::makeTxDbFromGFF=Used to create custom TxDb objects from GTF/GFF3 files before using txcutr ;; txdbmaker::makeTxDbFromBiomart=Used to retrieve and build TxDb objects from BioMart resources
- when_to_use: When analyzing RNA-sequencing libraries generated from specific transcript ends (such as Lexogen Quant-Seq or 10X Chromium Single Cell 3') and quantifying alternative cleavage and polyadenylation (APA) site usage.
- pitfalls: High memory usage=Truncation can be computationally intensive and memory-heavy, requiring 3-4GB RAM per core when using parallel processing on mammalian transcriptomes ;; Incomplete annotations=GENCODE annotations may contain transcripts without validated 3' ends; the documentation recommends pre-filtering entries with the tag mRNA_end_NF before running txcutr

workflows.name: transcriptome_truncation_and_export
workflows.intent: Truncate a transcriptome annotation from the 3' end and export the resulting GTF, FASTA, and merge table for downstream alignment and quantification.
input: sacCer3 (A BSgenome object matching the TxDb genome)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the TxDb object and optionally restrict to specific chromosomes ;; 2. Truncate the transcriptome using truncateTxome ;; 3. Export the truncated annotation to a GTF file using exportGTF ;; 4. Export the truncated transcript sequences to a FASTA file using exportFASTA ;; 5. Generate a merge table using generateMergeTable to map input transcripts to output transcripts or genes
workflows.code:
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(TxDb.Scerevisiae.UCSC.sacCer3.sgdGene)
txdb <- TxDb.Scerevisiae.UCSC.sacCer3.sgdGene

## constrain to "chrI"
seqlevels(txdb) <- "chrI"

## view the lengths of first ten transcripts
transcriptLengths(txdb)[1:10,]

library(txcutr)

txdb_w500 <- truncateTxome(txdb, maxTxLength=500)

transcriptLengths(txdb_w500)[1:10,]

gtf_file <- tempfile("sacCer3_chrI.sgd.txcutr_w500", fileext=".gtf.gz")
exportGTF(txdb_w500, file=gtf_file)

library(BSgenome.Scerevisiae.UCSC.sacCer3)
sacCer3 <- BSgenome.Scerevisiae.UCSC.sacCer3

fasta_file <- tempfile("sacCer3_chrI.sgd.txcutr_w500", fileext=".fa.gz")
exportFASTA(txdb_w500, genome=sacCer3, file=fasta_file)

df_merge <- generateMergeTable(txdb_w500, minDistance=500)

head(df_merge, 10)

df_merge[df_merge$tx_in != df_merge$tx_out,]

transcripts(txdb_w500, columns=c("tx_name", "gene_id"),
            filter=list(gene_id=c("YAL026C")))
